evidence: the development, deployment and use of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning in our operations and those of our service providers and partners could introduce new risks

increased exposure to cybersecurity threats and social engineering, inadvertent disclosure or misuse of confidential, proprietary or personal information, errors, bias or other unexpected outcomes in AI outputs
AI adoption may require significant investment, specialized talent and access to high quality data, and our competitors may adopt AI more effectively than we do
advancements in AI pose serious risks for many of the traditional tools used to identify individuals, including voice recognition, facial recognition
generative AI systems are increasingly used by malicious actors to create more sophisticated cyber-attacks and to circumvent controls
ai_positioning.summary: FANG adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques opérationnels, cybersécuritaires et concurrentiels plutôt que sur les opportunités de développement ou d'intégration.
